question: How is that liṅga regarded in comparison to all other liṅgas?
premises: One liṅga is singled out as supreme
inference: That liṅga is considered the most worshipable of all liṅgas.
uncertainties: pajyatamaṃ: unusual form, taken as superlative of worshipable
plain_english: Indeed, that is considered the most worshipable of all liṅgas.
